asia.read: Asian equities are broadly lower, averaging -1.31%. Risk came off overnight, which normally gives gold a small bid into London. Gold moved -0.58% overnight in a 0.88% range, and comes into London near the bottom of it. Sitting on the lows into the open leaves it vulnerable to a flush if London sells it. 2 minor Asian releases overnight, none of them the kind that reaches gold.
asia.caveat: Measured from 00:00 UK to 11:12. Tokyo closes around 07:00 UK and Hong Kong around 09:00, so this is a session finishing rather than one that has finished.

correlations.regime: Gold and the dollar are running at -0.52. That is the textbook inverse relationship, so dollar moves are doing real work on the price. Against the S&P it is +0.36. Gold is trading WITH risk assets rather than against them, so it is behaving as a liquidity asset right now, not a hedge - do not rely on it to offset an equity drawdown while that holds.

headlines.title: ‘Season of fear’: Escalating Israeli attacks on West Bank olive farmers, deadly strikes on Gaza
headlines.summary: Israeli attacks on war-torn Gaza over the weekend killed at least six Palestinians, including children, despite a year-old ceasefire agreement.
